description: This Java class defines the response to a ModifyFeatures command for a 'thing' in the Eclipse Ditto model. It includes methods for creating instances representing different response statuses, parsing from JSON, and managing features associated with the thing.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a ModifyFeatures command, with functionality to create, parse from JSON, and expose status and feature data.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a response indicating features were created, with deprecated overload accepting String as Thing ID.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a response indicating features were modified, with deprecated overload accepting String as Thing ID.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or object into a ModifyFeaturesResponse instance.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the thing associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeaturesCreated
methods.description: Returns the features created or modified, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the features according to the specified schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer resource path for the features.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the payload information to a JSON object builder, considering the schema and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response with the given DittoHeaders, based on the current status code.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare response objects.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the response object.
